def compute_power(base, exp):
    res = 1
    MOD = 1000000007
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
        base = (base * base) % MOD
    return res

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    if k == 0:
        print(compute_power(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(compute_power(p, p))
        return
    checked = [False] * (p)
    total_groups = 0
    for i in range(1, p):
        if checked[i]:
            continue
        current = i
        while not checked[current]:
            checked[current] = True
            current = (current * k) % p
        total_groups += 1
    print(compute_power(p, total_groups))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
